IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Rate: %1, souring at %2 of full speed. The time left assumes the temperature holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_NoBo: You need an empty bottle on you or in a container nearby.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Empt: Pours away everything in the cask. The mother stays.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Need: Only steeped grain goes in here
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Crow: Over %1 L the culture gets too little air and works slower.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Star: The mother is working %1 faster, with sour vinegar left as a starter.
The mother works %1 faster once the pool is at least %2 soured. Keep at least a third as much vinegar as the fermented wort you plan to add, and it works from the start.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Need: Needs at least 10 L of wort in the tank
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Vess: Fermentation Vessel: %1 L of wort waiting
Fermentation Vessel: fermenting %1 L of wort, %2 done
Fermentation Vessel: %1 L of fermented wort ready

Pour in 10 or 20 L of wort, put a full packet of yeast in the slot and press Craft in the vessel's window. A run takes whole buckets, one or two, and gives back 9.5 L of fermented wort for every 10 L.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_NoWo: You need a container holding only wort, on you or nearby.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_NoCo: You need an empty container on you or nearby.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_NoFe: You need a container holding only fermented wort, on you or nearby.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Draw: Draw off the fermented wort first
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Need: Only a packet of yeast goes in this slot. Wort goes in the tank.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Full: A run needs a full packet of yeast
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Cask: Orléans Vinegar Cask: %1 L, ready to bottle, %2
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Take: Lifts the whole mother into an empty jar. The cask sours slower without one. In the jar it lives about a month.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Spli: Peels one layer off into an empty jar and leaves the rest working in the cask. Use it to start another cask.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_AddM: Lays the mother from its jar into this cask and gives the jar back.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_NoJa: You need an empty jar on you or nearby.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_NoMo: You need a Mother of Vinegar in a jar. A cask grows its own the first time it fully sours.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Dead: Your Mother of Vinegar has died. A mother in a jar only lives about a month.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Laye: Mother layers: %1. It grows a layer for about every %2 L of vinegar it makes, and can be split from 2.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Hose: Hose connected to an Orléans Vinegar Cask
Hose connected to a Fermentation Vessel

A rubber hose from the vessel's tap to the cask. Use Pump to Cask on either station to send fermented wort across in the amount you choose, instead of carrying it. Uses up the hose. Needs pliers, which you keep. Neither station can be picked up while joined.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Deta: Takes the hose off and gives it back. Needs pliers, which you keep.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_NoCa: Needs an Orléans Vinegar Cask without a hose within 2 squares of the vessel, on the same floor.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Need: You need pliers in your inventory.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Info: The time left assumes today's temperature holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Pump: The vessel has no fermented wort to pump.
The cask has room for only %1 L. Bottle some vinegar first.
The vessel has only %1 L of fermented wort.
The cask is already at the air line (%1 L). More than that slows the souring.
Fills the cask to %1 L, the most it holds at full souring speed.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_Spli: The mother needs 2 layers before a layer can be split off. It has %1, and grows the next once the cask has made about %2 L more vinegar.
